card.name: Partway through rare proper names
card.fires_on: The middle of an uncommon proper name or coined word split into pieces, such as a film title, place name or acronym, in general web text. It also fires on a few odd spots like 'other' after 'Among'.

modes.label: Split rare names
modes.description: A piece in the middle of a rare place, title or organization name.

modes.label: Acronyms and web names
modes.description: A piece inside a capitalized acronym or web address.

card.writes: Promotes odd name and word pieces and suppresses words for news and stories, so it has no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of unusual names that get broken into several pieces.
